title: Adjustable Bench Supply (Bridge + LM317)
description: A bridge rectifier and reservoir capacitor feed an LM317-style adjustable regulator; two resistors set the output voltage.

education.summary: The regulator holds its output 1.25 V above the ADJ pin. R1 and R2 form a divider from OUT to ADJ to ground, so the ratio R2/R1 sets the output voltage.
objectives: Follow AC through a bridge rectifier to a smoothed DC rail
Calculate the output voltage of an adjustable regulator
Explain why the input must stay above the output (dropout)
education.theory: Vout = 1.25 × (1 + R2 / R1) + Iadj × R2. With R1 = 240 Ω and R2 = 720 Ω the output is 5 V. The unregulated input must exceed the output by about 3 V.
questions: What output voltage does R2 = 1.2 kΩ give with R1 = 240 Ω?
What happens to the output if R2 is replaced by a short?
Why is C2 placed at the input of the regulator and C3 at the output?
experiments: Replace R2 with a 2 kΩ potentiometer and plot Vout against wiper position.
